## Notes (round 4)

- Transcript source: eeawNrRi-cc = YouTube auto-captions (the subtitle endpoint answered again on 2026-11-05); the other 5 videos = Whisper large-v3 int8 (6 threads).
- Failure cause of the 3 qwen3.5:4b runs (k1xJbNAGmFg, zVc-S0Od8_0, iM3YsKfRh6E): in each, the roster call succeeded (160-175 s, 18-21 output tokens) and the first chunk call hit the 900 s call timeout (TimeoutError; no Ollama timing for that call). Memory was ample (min MemAvailable 6.1-6.3 GB, PSI full10 0.00, swap-in 1-4 MB). Why the call ran long is not observed; qwen's successful chunk calls elsewhere generate 2000-3000 tokens at about 4.5-5 tok/s, which on a 6k-token prompt exceeds 900 s. Stop rule (3 failures) then retired qwen; it was not run on hoYWNqh_u5I, eeawNrRi-cc, SMFV5A8aq0c.
